validation_approach: Use `cue vet <schema>.cue <data>.json` to validate JSON against CUE schemas. The loader module provides validate_cue_with_executor which uses shellout to run cue commands. Pattern: execute cue vet, parse result, return Ok(Nil) or Error(LoadError)
jsonl_parsing: JSONL is newline-delimited JSON. Parse by: (1) read file with simplifile.read, (2) split by \n with string.split, (3) filter empty lines, (4) parse each line with json.decode. See interview_storage.gleam for JSONL patterns
schema_usage: ai_schema.get_schema(command: cmd, schema_type: type) returns CUE schema content. Schemas are in schema/ai/input/*.cue and schema/ai/output/*.cue. Use simplifile to write temp files for validation
command_structure: Pattern: (1) glint.command(fn(input) {...}), (2) Parse flags with flag.get_string/get_bool, (3) Match on args/flags, (4) Execute logic, (5) Return JSON using json_output.success or json_output.failure, (6) Call halt(exit_code). See ai_schema_command() lines 4010-4250
error_handling: Use json_output.error(code, message) for errors. json_output.failure() wraps errors in response. Exit codes: exit_pass=0, exit_fail=1, exit_invalid=3, exit_error=4. All commands return JSON via json_output.output(response)
validation_strategy: For each JSONL line: (1) parse as JSON, (2) write to temp file, (3) run `cue vet <schema>.cue <temp>.json`, (4) collect results. Return aggregate success/failure with line numbers for errors
temp_file_approach: Use simplifile.create_temporary_file or write to /tmp/intent-validate-*.json, then delete after validation
